name: Deployment Operator Preflight

checks.action: Install Docker Desktop on Windows or Docker Engine on Linux.

checks.detail: Docker daemon unavailable or not running
checks.action: Start Docker Desktop/Engine, then retry this preflight.
Restore compose.production.example.yml from the release package.

checks.detail: VIDGRAVITY_PUBLIC_BASE_URL is missing or not HTTPS
checks.action: Set the public HTTPS URL only after DNS and TLS are configured.

checks.detail: One or more Razorpay environment variables are missing (values hidden)
checks.action: Set test-mode secrets in the host secret manager; do not commit .env.production.
Prefer host-managed secrets; on Linux restrict env-file permissions to owner only.

checks.detail: Skipped because Docker/Compose prerequisites are not available
checks.action: Rerun preflight on the deployment host.

security_note: Secret values are never included in this report. Passing this preflight does not prove a live deployment, successful payments/downloads, egress isolation, or security acceptance.
